fields.statement: At dffc827d: go test -trimpath -count=1 -run TestPlan ./internal/guide passes; TestPlanText's new plan-serves-milestone leaf asserts RHIZA_MILESTONE, 'reach one, directly or through an intent under one' and 'umbrella or area intent under no' milestone. A fresh build's `rhiza guide plan` prints the new paragraph in step 2; the rhiza-plan skill is generated from the same embedded plan.md, so the skill copy is in step. make self-check reports no failure except render staleness of actor files and index.md, which rhiza render regenerates after landing; fmt/vet/full suite left to the PR's CI.
